ns2:course.label: Agricultural and Food Policies
ns2:course.description: Analysis of agricultural and food policies and programs and their effects on producers and consumers of agricultural products. Formulation of agricultural and food policies are examined with an emphasis on historical and current economic problems affecting agriculture and rural America. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ACE 300, ECON 302, or consent of instructor.
